g.text: Arrows run from parent (PK) to child (FK). Not drawn: pipeline_runs -> incidents (run_id); anomalies -> incident_anomalies;
root_cause_analyses -> reports (rca_id). audit_logs and security_findings are standalone tables (no foreign keys).
